verdict.rationale: Trello's own site claims built-in automation ('Automate tasks and workflows with Trello'), but nothing in the pack shows user-defined rules or event-based triggers. Power-Up buttons and REST webhooks are developer building blocks rather than rule automation, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation of rule definition, event-trigger types and resulting actions, any limits or plan tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate tasks and workflows with Trello.
